app.name: Tessa electricity SE
app.summary: A responsive electricity price dashboard with a 48-hour graph, sensor-native currency, and custom delivery and sales tariffs.
app.tile_example: The price now and the day's graph
app.unit_hint: Show the sensor currency per kWh, or convert its numeric price to cents per kWh.
app.decimals_hint: Sets price decimals shown on the dashboard and the maximum decimal places allowed in tax and cost inputs.
app.feed_in_hint: The selected sensor price plus the sales additional cost per kWh.
app.delivery_hint: Calculated as sensor price × (1 + tax rate) + additional cost. The additional cost is entered after tax, in the sensor currency per kWh.
app.tax_hint: Enter a percentage with up to two whole digits and up to the selected number of decimals. For example, 25 or 25.5.
app.delivery_additional_hint: Added after tax, in the sensor currency per kWh. Up to two whole digits and the selected number of decimals; negative values are allowed.
app.show_sales_hint: Show the selected price sensor plus the sales additional cost. This Tessera version allows one sensor per tile.
app.sales_additional_hint: Added to the selected sensor price, in its currency per kWh. Up to two whole digits and the selected number of decimals; negative values are allowed.
app.graph_hint: Bars, or a stepped line that follows the price slot by slot. The card shows the graph of the tile you open it from.
app.fill_hint: With a stepped line: a faint fill under it, down to zero or to the feed-in price.
app.grid_hint: Lines across the graph at the price labels it shows.
app.ahead_hint: The graph shows the 24 hours from now instead of today and tomorrow. Before tomorrow's prices are in, it ends at midnight.
